lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣਿ ਛੁਟਕਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man saadh saran chhutakaaraa ||
lines.translation: O my mind, emancipation is attained in the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਰਹਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਤ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur poore janam maran na rahaee phir aavat baaro baaraa || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without the Perfect Guru, births and deaths do not cease, and one comes and goes, over and over again. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਜੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ohu j bharam bhulaavaa kaheeat tin mahi urajhio sagal sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: The whole world is entangled in what is called the delusion of doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਤੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਾ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਤੇ ਨਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pooran bhagat purakh suaamee kaa sarab thok te niaaraa ||2||
lines.translation: The perfect devotee of the Primal Lord God remains detached from everything. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤੈ ਏਹੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dau naahee kaahoo baatai ehu khasam kaa keeaa ||
lines.translation: Don't indulge in slander for any reason, for everything is the creation of the Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਉ ਲੀਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau kripaa karee prabh merai mil saadhasa(n)gat naau leeaa ||3||
lines.translation: One who is blessed with the Mercy of my God, dwells on the Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਤ ਉਧਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham paramesur satigur sabhanaa karat udhaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the True Guru, saves all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਰੀਐ ਇਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak gur bin nahee tareeai ihu pooran tat beechaaraa ||4||9||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, without the Guru, no one crosses over; this is the perfect essence of all contemplation. ||4||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: khojat khojat khoj beechaario raam naam tat saaraa ||
lines.translation: I have searched and searched and searched, and found that the Lord's Name is the most sublime reality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kilabikh kaate nimakh araadhiaa guramukh paar utaaraa ||1||
lines.translation: Contemplating it for even an instant, sins are erased; the Gurmukh is carried across and saved. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ras peevahu purakh giaanee ||
lines.translation: Drink in the sublime essence of the Lord's Name, O man of spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਹਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sun mahaa tripat man paavai saadhoo a(n)mrit baanee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Listening to the Ambrosial Words of the Holy Saints, the mind finds absolute fulfillment and satisfaction. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukat bhugat jugat sach paaeeai sarab sukhaa kaa daataa ||
lines.translation: Liberation, pleasures, and the true way of life are obtained from the Lord, the Giver of all peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: apune daas kau bhagat daan devai pooran purakh bidhaataa ||2||
lines.translation: The Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny, blesses His slave with the gift of devotional worship. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਰਸਨਾ ਗਾਈਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sravanee suneeai rasanaa gaaeeai hiradai dhiaaeeai soee ||
lines.translation: Hear with your ears, and sing with your tongue, and meditate within your heart on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran samarath suaamee jaa te brithaa na koee ||3||
lines.translation: The Lord and Master is all-powerful, the Cause of causes; without Him, there is nothing at all. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag ratan janam paaiaa karahu kripaa kirapaalaa ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, I have obtained the jewel of human life; have mercy on me, O Merciful Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak gun gaavai simarai sadaa goupaalaa ||4||10||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and contemplates Him forever in meditation. ||4||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਅਰੋਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar isanaan simar prabh apanaa man tan bhae arogaa ||
lines.translation: After taking your cleansing bath, remember your God in meditation, and your mind and body shall be free of disease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਲਾਥੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kot bighan laathe prabh saranaa pragate bhale sa(n)jogaa ||1||
lines.translation: Millions of obstacles are removed, in the Sanctuary of God, and good fortune dawns. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh baanee sabad subhaakhiaa ||
lines.translation: The Word of God's Bani, and His Shabad, are the best utterances.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪੜਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavahu sunahu paRahu nit bhaaee gur poorai too raakhiaa || rahaau ||
lines.translation: So constantly sing them, listen to them, and read them, O Siblings of Destiny, and the Perfect Guru shall save you. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਮਿਤਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib amit vadaaee bhagat vachhal daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: The glorious greatness of the True Lord is immeasurable; the Merciful Lord is the Lover of His devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਆਦਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)taa kee paij rakhadaa aaiaa aad birad pratipaalaa ||2||
lines.translation: He has preserved the honor of His Saints; from the very beginning of time, His Nature is to cherish them. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਭੁੰਚਹੁ ਸਰਬ ਵੇਲਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har a(n)mrit naam bhojan nit bhu(n)chahu sarab velaa mukh paavahu ||
lines.translation: So eat the Ambrosial Name of the Lord as your food; put it into your mouth at all times.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਤਾਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਾਠਾ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaraa maraa taap sabh naathaa gun gobi(n)d nit gaavahu ||3||
lines.translation: The pains of old age and death shall all depart, when you constantly sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sunee aradaas suaamee merai sarab kalaa ban aaee ||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer, and all my affairs have been resolved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਈ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: pragat bhaee sagale jug a(n)tar gur naanak kee vadiaaee ||4||11||
lines.translation: The glorious greatness of Guru Nanak is manifest, throughout all the ages. ||4||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ghar 2 chaupade ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Chau-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਏਕਸ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਹਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek pitaa ekas ke ham baarik too meraa gur haaee ||
lines.translation: The One God is our father; we are the children of the One God. You are our Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sun meetaa jeeu hamaaraa bal bal jaasee har darasan dehu dikhaaee ||1||
lines.translation: Listen, friends: my soul is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You; O Lord, reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||
